result.detail:
Risks to watch in the platform runs:
(a) LAST is computed with a part-select of the DEPTH parameter (DEPTH[PW-1:0] - 1). I expect Verilator, Icarus and Yosys to accept this, but it has not been tried.
(b) The formal block uses $past, anyconst and a combinational memory read. If formal.run fails, removing sync_fifo.sby makes the formal requirement not applicable, but section 7 of the interface spec would then be unmet and should be escalated.
(c) The testbench avoids width mismatches in case Verilator's default WIDTH warnings are fatal in the simulation build.
Recorded decisions still needed: no DEPTH 5 proof, and no sync_fifo_tb_fail.v. A break-the-design mutation check on the testbench has not been done.
